summary: All three blocking findings are still valid and require direct spec changes before gate.

items.title: Draft approval owner is unspecified after removing review mutation
items.target: R1, R6, R7, Data Flow, gate-draft
items.rationale: The spec removes draft review mutation but does not assign draft approval mutation to a later phase, which can leave gate-draft blocked after a clean coverage review.
items.evidence: spec.json R1/R6 prohibit review mutation; current review code has approveDraftAfterCoverageReview(), and gate-draft validates draft lifecycle approval.

items.title: Draft triage decision semantics are missing
items.rationale: The spec asks gate-draft to validate allowed decisions and unresolved blocking state, but it has no enum or gate meaning for draft triage decisions.
items.evidence: spec.json R4 only says triage records a decision; spec-review.json finding notes existing draft repair has requires_user_decision semantics that are not mapped.

items.title: Active-flow migration lacks status rules for inserted draft leaves
items.rationale: The spec requires active-flow migration but does not define inserted step statuses for flows already beyond draft review, which can break next-action ordering.
items.evidence: spec.json R9 mentions inserting leaves and artifact reference updates but not status synthesis or old artifact handling.
